text.brief: The Gaden Phodrang Trust in India convenes a search committee in the season after the succession opens. In Lhasa the same week, officials announce a golden urn ceremony and invite foreign diplomats to attend.
text.record: The Dalai Lama stated on July 2, 2025 that the Gaden Phodrang Trust alone holds authority to recognize his reincarnation. The Foreign Ministry answered that any successor needs the central government's approval. The Tibetan Policy and Support Act of 2020 makes it American policy that Tibetan Buddhists alone choose the successor.
text.reading: The Party borrows the authority of a religious office and fills it with its own candidate. It asks governments, companies and search engines to recognize the choice and punishes those who refuse. AI assistants that repeat the state's answer finish the work. This is Stratagem 14, borrow a corpse to resurrect the soul.
text.coreEvent: Rival claimants to the Dalai Lama's succession gain recognition from different authorities before 2036.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. Democracies never decided in advance who may choose a religious leader, so the Party framed the question first.
text.fix: Settle the principle before the succession opens. The faith chooses its leaders, and democracies recognize the faith's choice.
